products.description: Every product in your catalogue. Each belongs to a category and holds its own variants.

fields.title: Title
fields.titleHelp: The product name shown to customers.
fields.slugHelp: Generated from the title and locked — the product URL never changes.
fields.descriptionHelp: Shown on the product page. Plain text.
fields.statusHelp: Draft is hidden; Active is public; Archived is retired.
fields.categoryHelp: Required. Products are grouped by category in the shop.
fields.publishAtHelp: Schedule a draft to go live automatically at this time.
fields.addCategoryHelp: Creates a category; the slug is generated from the title.
fields.tagsHelp: Free-form labels for internal filtering and search.
fields.optionsHelp: Define axes like Size or Colour; each combination becomes a variant.
fields.seoTitleHelp: Overrides the browser tab / search title. Optional.
fields.seoDescriptionHelp: Meta description for search results. Optional.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: Each purchasable combination — its SKU, price, and stock.
variants.skuHelp: Unique stock-keeping code for this variant.
variants.priceHelp: The selling price for this variant.
variants.compareAtHelp: Original price to show as struck-through.
variants.stockHelp: Units on hand. Changes here are recorded in the inventory ledger.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Every product belongs to a category. The order here is the order sections appear on the shop.
categories.addHelpEmpty: The slug is generated from the title and never changes.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.description: Live stock for every variant. Adjust levels or receive new stock — all changes are logged below.
inventory.searchHelp: Filter by product title or SKU.
inventory.errPositive: Enter a positive whole number to add
inventory.adjustmentsDescription: The full stock history — sales, restocks, manual edits, and returns.
